# Agent guide: doqs

This is the entry page for every agent: Claude Code, Cursor, and others. It is the same in every
Refaqt repository, apart from the name and the parts that come from `.agents-local/`.

## First step

Run `ls .agents/rules/core.md`. If a file is missing, run `git submodule update --init --remote --checkout .agents`, then check again. Agents never run `.bat`
files. Never commit inside `.agents/`: those folders belong to other repositories, and they
are meant to sit ahead of the commit this repository records.

## Rules for every task

Other agents: read `.agents/rules/core.md`. Claude Code already has it, through this import:
@.agents/rules/core.md

## This repository

Other agents: read `.agents-local/rules/repo.md`. Claude Code already has it, through this import:
@.agents-local/rules/repo.md

## Read only when the task needs it

Do not read these at the start. Open one when your task matches its line. Claude Code also offers
the skills by name.
